gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that an instant with a non-zero nanosecond fraction is reported as being after the same instant once its fraction is cleared to zero.
ADDED i2: A negative nano adjustment is normalised: the seconds count is rolled back by one and the nanoseconds become 1_000_000_000 - 1194 = 999998806.
ADDED i3: Clearing the nano fraction keeps the same second but resets nanos to zero.
ADDED i4: Same seconds, but the original has a larger nano fraction, so it is later.
